{{Top|leg}}
The '''fern-tree''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew in tropical climes. It had massive fronds that were large enough to support small life forms. Fern-trees grew in the jungles of [[Duroon]]<ref name="HSSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref> and on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], where multiple specimens were located in [[The Greenwell]] of the [[Bakur Memorial Building]].<ref name="TAB-SB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
